scope: W01a inlet/upstream-forcing wave activation from computed calm fields at actual absolute CFD time0.587s, without global initialization or clear. User explicitly waived calm settling wait.

design.initialization: Do not initialize, clear, reset time, or change continuum initial-condition profiles. Preserve computed calm physical fields.
design.binding: Only inlet velocity and water phase profiles and existing upstream forcing-wave target. Existing forcing zone -35..-15m generates distributed waves; core and downstream damping remain unchanged.
design.ramp: Height Hmin+(Htarget-Hmin)*(1-cos(pi*clamp((Time-activation_time)/(2*Tref),0,1)))/2. Hmin=1e-6m; Tref=.8472673206891129s; nominal duration1.6945346413782258s. Mean18m/s flow is not ramped.
design.interpretation: The time-varying height is a controlled inlet startup envelope, not an exact steady FifthOrder wavetrain during the ramp. Full-height nonlinear coefficient refresh requires runtime verification.
design.absolute_time: FirstWaveFront=false avoids assuming newly created front position is independent of nonzero CFD time. It creates analytic references throughout the domain; without initialize those references do not replace computed interior fields.
design.physical_risk: The phase/time/pressure consistency and wave-specific numerical stability remain guarded. No turbulence-viscosity limiter increase or causal claim from a warning is justified.

primary_documentation.title: VOF Wave Type Reference
primary_documentation.evidence: FirstWaveFront initial front/flat-water convention; OFF supplies domainwide analytical wave at initialization. Wave period calculated when initialized. No FifthOrder activation time-origin API established.

primary_documentation.title: Setting Values Using an Expression
primary_documentation.evidence: Constant scalar input can reference time-dependent $Time and explicit units.

primary_documentation.title: Expressions
primary_documentation.evidence: Spatially invariant time expressions are valid constant scalar inputs. This generic support alone does not establish native wave coefficient cache refresh.

primary_documentation.title: VOF Waves Model Reference
primary_documentation.evidence: EnableTheoryComparison updates inner-domain analytic fields. These are analytic comparisons, not proof of changed physical fields.

primary_documentation.title: VOF Wave Forcing and Damping
primary_documentation.evidence: Forcing acts through momentum; do not add phase mass source to conceal imbalance.

primary_documentation.title: Global Parameters
primary_documentation.evidence: Do not use a time-dependent global parameter; apply time expression to wave-height physical quantity.

zero_step_evidence.analytic_gauges_and_velocity: NaN for both expression and constant new FifthOrder objects.
zero_step_evidence.conclusion: Newly created wave caches were not initialized by quantity setters or report evaluation in a loaded solution. This is not evidence that the height expression is unsupported. Required guarded runtime step probe follows.

native_vorticity.meaning: omega_y = du/dz - dw/dx; actual computed field, not a finite-difference substitute.

runtime_probe.requirements: No initialization/clear. Before/after configuration force/mass/time fingerprints identical. First actual step must have finite actual fields, speed<50m/s, alpha bounded[0,1], exact time increment, finite analytic period/gauges/velocity. Failure saves and stops immediately.
runtime_probe.limitation: Three steps near zero ramp height establish startup readiness only, not full-height nonlinear cache correctness. Production must continue to record evaluated H, period, analytic velocity/gauges and physical/balance guards.

completed_result.note: Three near-zero-height runtime steps test immediate cache readiness only. They do not validate full-height nonlinear ramp refresh or wave-force accuracy.

cycle_repeatability.minimum: Four consecutive complete cycles after full ramp has arrived at the foil and gauge station; no mandatory10cycleminimum.
cycle_repeatability.clock: Preserve absolute CSV time; add activation/ramp completion/measured arrival metadata and a cycle origin for consistent complete-cycle bins.
cycle_repeatability.arrival: Do not use a simplistic35m/c travel delay: forcing generation is distributed from-35to-15m. Measure actual local wave arrival/full-height gauge establishment.
cycle_repeatability.meaning: Repeatable force cycles establish periodicity, not mesh/time/wave-force accuracy. Calm startup without settling is not an accepted matched calm force baseline.
cycle_repeatability.over20: A diagnostic warning to inspect setup, drift, reflections and numerical behavior; not a mathematical proof of invalidity.

guards: Retain0.01%inlet phase/boundary mass review, native error and BDF2, physical50m/s,alpha,time/resource guards. No mass correction or weakened criterion.
gauge_geometry_caution: Full-depth water-area planes crossing the foil include solid-displacement offset. At Hnearzero x0 reference is minus4.888mm, not level drift. Use actual-reference on the same plane or a verified calm geometric offset.
